subject.title: fix: include pnpm 11 bins in gateway PATH

question: Should this PR intentionally change managed service PATH precedence so trusted system directories come before user/package-manager directories while adding pnpm 11 bin coverage?
rationale: Automation can verify the code shape and tests, but accepting the upgrade-visible PATH precedence change is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Accept guarded precedence change
options.body: Land the PR with system-before-user service PATH precedence as the intended hardening, while preserving pnpm 10 and pnpm 11 directory coverage.

options.title: Require compatibility-preserving variant
options.body: Ask for a follow-up patch that adds pnpm 11 bins without changing service PATH precedence for existing installs.

options.title: Pause until refreshed
options.body: Wait for a current-main refresh and recheck if the behind branch changes the merge result.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded precedence change
recommendation.body: Land the PR with system-before-user service PATH precedence as the intended hardening, while preserving pnpm 10 and pnpm 11 directory coverage.
